amendment_reason: P2-D0 corrected full17 versus OHLCV13 availability-aware same-common-row preregistration boundary

common.decision_timestamp: decision row t is observed after the close of bar t
common.fill_timestamp: action-capable h4 block fills at the close of bar t+1 after decision t

full17.missing_feature_policy: fail closed; no zero fill, interpolation, or feature synthesis

ohlcv13.description: the first 13 columns of canonical full17, with no reordering
ohlcv13.source: canonical v4 feature body column projection only
ohlcv13.missing_feature_policy: the seven funding/basis columns are omitted by fixed projection, never zero-filled

feature_arms.shared_common_row_rule: construct full17 context and target/availability eligibility first; the full17 and OHLCV13 arms use exactly the intersection of those eligible row masks, identical timestamp rows, identical horizon, split, purge, and finite-prediction support; neither arm may recover rows from the other or compact the grid
feature_arms.row_intersection_formula: common_mask[t,h] = context_eligible_full17[t] AND target_complete_full17[t,h] AND finite_ohlcv13[t] AND finite_full17[t] AND finite_return_window[t,h]

target_contract.required_edges: every exact 15m edge t->t+1 through t+h-1->t+h
target_contract.zero_rule: finite exact zero is a valid target and maps to binary class 0
target_contract.gap_rule: any missing, non-finite, or non-contiguous required target row invalidates the complete horizon and retains its timestamp and false mask

context_contract.required_rows: every row in [t-63,t] has finite canonical full17 features and spot_bar_observed=true, funding_rate_available=true, mark_close_available=true
context_contract.required_edges: every exact 15m edge from t-63->t-62 through t-1->t
context_contract.model_input: pass only the arm's current-row feature vector at t; never flatten or append the context
context_contract.gap_rule: retain original timestamp rows and set context_eligible=false for every window crossing a timestamp gap

split_contract.timestamp_frequency: exactly 15 minutes for each contiguous edge; timestamp gaps are retained and exclude crossing windows
split_contract.range_semantics: all timestamp ranges are UTC [start,end) right-exclusive; the end timestamp is excluded and no target, fill, or four-bar outcome may cross it
split_contract.purge_rule: fit rows must satisfy target_end <= the right-exclusive evaluation origin minus 16 bars and row < origin
split_contract.right_exclusive_rule: fit, calibration, validation, and report masks are applied before metrics; cross-boundary target/fill/outcome tails are false/N/A, never clipped or reassigned
split_contract.nested_rule: train fit precedes inner calibration; all calibration choices are frozen before outer validation; historical report-only rows cannot select, tune, calibrate, or gate

common.minimum_history_rule: count eligible context AND target AND purge AND row<origin train-mask rows separately for every feature arm, model, task, horizon, seed, and fit origin; if fewer than 16384, mark that fit N/A and do not promote

learned_fit_contract.train_mask: context_eligible AND target_complete[h] AND target_end <= origin - purge_bars AND row < origin, intersected with the fixed common-row mask
learned_fit_contract.feature_scaler: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True) fit separately for each arm, model, task, origin, and horizon using only train-mask rows; sklearn ddof=0; zero-variance scale is 1; transform-only thereafter
learned_fit_contract.one_class_rule: a LogisticRegression or HistGradientBoostingClassifier prefix with one observed class is N/A; never repair, oversample, or synthesize a class
learned_fit_contract.future_target_rule: outer-validation and report-only target rows cannot enter fit, scaler, calibration, or hyperparameter selection

ridge.action_role: h4 continuous action candidate; h1/h8/h16 forecast-only

logistic.action_role: forecast-only proper-score diagnostic; no utility/action output

hist_gradient_boosting.action_role: h4 continuous action candidate; h1/h8/h16 forecast-only

candidate_families.family_selection: candidate family, feature arm, task, horizon, hyperparameters, and seed list are fixed before any output; no post-output family expansion or deletion

common.seed_rule: all feature arms for a seed share identical timestamp rows, availability masks, target masks, split boundaries, and causal fit schedule; only the fixed feature projection and model fit differ

calibration_contract.method: any probability calibration mapping, if used, is fit only on the fixed inner_calibration split after train fit and frozen before outer validation

action_contract.common_action_mask: same common full17/availability intersection for both feature arms

metrics.proper_score_rule: each metric is computed on identical common timestamp rows for full17 and OHLCV13 at one horizon; N/A/undefined denominators block and are never converted to zero
metrics.paired_utility_rule: h4 only; compare full17 and OHLCV13 on identical scored action rows with each policy's own carried inventory and an independent benchmark hold path
metrics.active_turnover_rule: report active indicator and turnover on the complete scheduled h4 grid including false/N/A rows; metrics exclude only by the fixed scored_action_mask
metrics.no_accuracy_claim: report-only historical rows and any observed 2023 result cannot be described as an untouched holdout or prospective accuracy claim

coverage_contract.potential_origin_rule: an origin is potential only when its 64-bar context and target tail t+1..t+h remain inside the same right-exclusive split
coverage_contract.common_row_fraction: common full17/availability-eligible rows divided by potential origins on the fixed split
coverage_contract.context_complete_fraction: complete common context rows divided by potential origins
coverage_contract.label_complete_fraction: complete target rows for h divided by potential origins
coverage_contract.finite_prediction_fraction: finite predictions divided by common eligible origins for each arm/model/task/horizon
coverage_contract.scored_action_fraction: scheduled complete four-bar blocks with common eligible origin, finite h4 forecast, complete fill, and complete outcome divided by all scheduled complete blocks
coverage_contract.undefined_policy: any missing arm/horizon/model/seed coverage field or non-finite denominator is N/A and blocks promotion

bootstrap.grid: complete fixed timestamp row grid in original order; false/N/A rows remain physically present and are never compacted
bootstrap.pairing: reuse identical sampled indices for full17 and OHLCV13 within every arm, seed, split, model, task, horizon, and block length
bootstrap.n_lt_block: comparison N/A/blocked; never circular wrap, gap compression, or denominator repair

statistical_contract.p_value: one-sided paired bootstrap p=(1+count of non-favorable replicates)/(B+1) per block length; conservative raw_p=max(p_8,p_16,p_32); only raw_p enters Holm
statistical_contract.holm_order: sort raw p ascending and break ties by comparison_id lexicographic order; reject only under fixed step-down alpha/(m-r+1)
statistical_contract.point_estimate: median of ten per-seed metric values for synthetic-style repeated seeds; S3 is not part of this D0 operation
statistical_contract.historical_report_role: historical_report_2023 is diagnostic/report-only and never enters the Holm family

historical_boundary.observed_data_policy: the existing 2018-2024 v4 body is historical; if 2023 rows were already observed during development, they are not a true untouched holdout
historical_boundary.future_stop_condition: stop before any promotion or prospective claim if no newly acquired, separately frozen, post-registration holdout exists; register its timestamps, source, content/schema hashes, and access boundary before use
historical_boundary.2023_role: report_only; never train, calibrate, select, gate, or count as an untouched holdout

runtime_contract.manifest_authentication: load_fixed_manifest first; canonical registered digest, critical fields, and results_observed=false are authoritative
runtime_contract.path_override_policy: only a complete explicit four-file path set may be supplied to the authenticated wrapper; any missing, unknown, symlinked, changed, or hash-mismatched file blocks before fit or score
runtime_contract.toctou_policy: snapshot regular-file dev, inode, size, mtime_ns, and mode before and after load/hash; any change blocks

runner_contract.production_entrypoint: a future P2 runner must call validate_p1_v4_runtime_inputs and cannot call the generic body validator as its production boundary
runner_contract.generic_train_app_forbidden: unidream.experiments.train_app.run_training_app is a legacy generic WM->BC->AC application and is not a P2-D0 research runner
runner_contract.d1_policy: D1 signed-flow acquisition is outside P2-D0 and must not be imported or executed
runner_contract.fit_score_execution: blocked in this preregistration-only module; no fit, score, accuracy result, or outer run may be started
runner_contract.action_primitive_start_condition: canonical action primitive producer and P1-specific MBB must be implemented and independently validated before h4 action utility is run; existing generic MBB is forbidden

primary_comparison_registry.holms_family: all rows with primary=true are one fixed Holm family; no row may be added, removed, reordered, or reclassified after output
